diagnosticWindows.label: v1.0.3-260917
changelog: [feature] Watch opens a live logcat view for the device
[feature] Filter live logcat by event type (verbose / debug / info / warning / error / fatal)
[feature] Watch on OneDrop shows nearby devices, send/receive, and why a transfer failed
[feature] Install Diagnostic from the AmL One shelf on Windows, Ubuntu, Mac Intel, and Apple Silicon
[improvement] Watch titles show the phone name and model with the serial, not the serial alone
[improvement] Pick an app splits official AOW, Made with App Builder, and third-party lists, with readable titles
[improvement] Device cards stay 370×182 and Watch / Apps use glass pictograms
[improvement] Settings explains why a DeepSeek key is useful and that Watch still works without one
[bugfix] Settings and window buttons sit flush on the right of the title bar again
[bugfix] Watch no longer repeats the window back control and device title on the page bar
[bugfix] Watch log stays still when you scroll up to read; live follow resumes at the bottom
[bugfix] Window title returns to Diagnostic after leaving Watch, instead of keeping the phone name
[bugfix] Settings uses the window title bar only — no second Settings header
[bugfix] Cancel on Diagnose stops bugreport immediately and goes back, instead of waiting then showing a stopped card
[bugfix] Home shows attached devices again instead of a blank window
[bugfix] Watch hides Show all logs until an app PID is known, so the switch is not stuck on
